name: nonApi_setTrackNotes
description: Fills a hasher's notes on a run from an imported file's title and description, only when they have none (E3.F4.S5). Called by the track-import processor for every activity that matched a run, whether or not the track was imported. A note the hasher wrote is never touched.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Title, blank line, description; trimmed; blank ⇒ no-op.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET Notes WHERE Notes IS NULL or blank — fires the updatedAt trigger.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
